# Best 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stands for iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods

## Top picks

**1. Best overall: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand, about $80–$98**
WIRED rated this one best after testing more than 30 models. It's a chrome "tree" design. Your iPhone and Watch hang in the air, and the AirPods sit on the round base. The iPhone pad tilts and works in landscape for StandBy mode.
- **Charging:** 15 W for iPhone, fast charging for Apple Watch Series 7 and later.
- **In the box:** 36 W power adapter.
- **Warranty:** 2 years.
- **Price:** WIRED listed it at $98 at Belkin, $90 at Amazon and $80 at Best Buy.
- Buy links are in WIRED's guide: https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/

**2. Fastest premium stand: Nomad Stand One Max, $169**
- **Charging:** 25 W Qi2 for iPhone, fast charging for Apple Watch.
- **Design:** Glossy black, and heavy enough that you can lift your phone off with one hand.
- **Catch:** No power adapter is included. You need one rated at 40 W or more.
- Source: https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/

**3. Best budget: ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station, about $40 on Amazon (list $80)**
WIRED called it the cheapest Qi2-certified 3-in-1 charger it had found.
- **Charging:** 15 W magnetic for iPhone.
- **In the box:** 33 W adapter and cable.
- **Bonus:** The Watch charger detaches, so you can take it with you.
- **Warranty:** 1 year.
- Source: https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/

## If you want 25 W charging

**ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1, Qi2.2 25 W, about $100**
- **Charging:** 25 W, with a cooling fan you can switch off at night.
- **Design:** Folds up for travel.
- **In the box:** 50 W adapter.
- Source: https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/
- **Coupon:** A coupon site says code **PARTNER18** took the price from $99.99 to about $82 at ESR's US store when it tested the code on October 23. That page uses affiliate links. Its warranty figure (12 months, or 24 with registration) also differs from WIRED's "2 years," so confirm the warranty at checkout. Page: https://dealectric.com/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand

**Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable, Qi2 25 W, $129.99**
- **Design:** The tallest and most adjustable foldable stand in its class, at over 70 mm high. That makes it good for a desk or FaceTime calls.
- **In the box:** 45 W adapter plus UK and EU plugs.
- Review: https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html

**Nimble Podium, about $130**
- **Design:** A pad style that lets your devices lie flat, so screens stay out of sight while you sleep.
- **Charging:** 25 W for iPhone, but Apple Watch charging is slow.
- Source: https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/

## Do you need 25 W?

Only some iPhones can use the full 25 W:
- **25 W:** iPhone 16 and 17 series, depending on the model and iOS version.
- **20 W:** iPhone Air, 16 and 16 Pro, according to ESR's specs.
- **15 W:** older iPhones.

If you mostly charge overnight, WIRED says 25 W makes little real difference. For most people, the **Belkin** or the budget **ESR at about $40** is the smart buy.

## A note on links

I can only share the review pages above, not direct retailer pages. The WIRED and Macworld articles link to current listings at Amazon, Best Buy and the brand stores. I'd skip the unbranded $15–$30 stands you'll see on Amazon, since none of them have been independently tested.
